sources.snippet: This model transcribes speech in lowercase Catalan and Spanish alphabet including spaces, and was fine-tuned on a Bilingual ca-es dataset comprising of 7426 hours. It is a "large" variant of Conformer-Transducer, with around 120 million parameters.
